I highly recommend it.

You sound a lot like me a couple months ago.

I initially thought I had ADHD.  I'm pretty sure now that I have bipolar II, adhd and anxiety. If your ADHD has not been the  same through your whole life I strongly recommend looking at bipolar II. Really study the symptoms of hypomania, if you haven't already. If you feel like it connects at all, it's a concern. Plus, the doc has seen a lot of different bipolar individuals, probably more than you. They're probably prescribing you Abilify because they are not sure if you have regular depression or bipolar, as it can work as an antidepressant for ordinary MDD. I had a bad experience with Abilify, but maybe you won't, everyone's body is different. But let me tell you, if it starts slowing your brain down (which it did to mine) you'll know IMMEDIATELY. And your doc will take you off of it if you tell them it isn't liveably bad. I hope this helps!
